bmc.label: Business Model Canvas
bmc.description: Models the business in 9 blocks: how it creates, delivers and captures value.

key_partners.label: Key partners
key_partners.hint: Who are your main partners and suppliers?

key_activities.label: Key activities
key_activities.hint: What does your value proposition require you to do?

key_resources.label: Key resources
key_resources.hint: What resources does your value proposition require? (physical, human, financial)

value_propositions.label: Value proposition
value_propositions.hint: What value do you deliver? Which problem do you solve?

customer_relationships.label: Customer relationships
customer_relationships.hint: What kind of relationship does each segment expect? (self-service, personal, community)

channels.label: Channels
channels.hint: How do you reach customers and deliver value to them?

customer_segments.label: Customer segments
customer_segments.hint: Who are you creating value for? Who are your most important customers?

cost_structure.label: Cost structure
cost_structure.hint: What are the most important costs in the model?

revenue_streams.label: Revenue streams
revenue_streams.hint: What value are customers paying for? How do they pay?

lean.label: Lean Canvas
lean.description: BMC adapted for startups: focused on problem, solution and metrics.

problem.label: Problem
problem.hint: Top 3 problems you solve. List existing alternatives.

solution.label: Solution
solution.hint: The 3 main features that solve the problems.

key_metrics.label: Key metrics
key_metrics.hint: The numbers that tell how the business is doing.

uvp.label: Unique value proposition
uvp.hint: A clear message that says why you're different and worth attention.

unfair_advantage.label: Unfair advantage
unfair_advantage.hint: Something that can't easily be copied or bought.

customer_segments.label: Customer segments
customer_segments.hint: Target customers. Mark the early adopters.

cost_structure.label: Cost structure
cost_structure.hint: Acquisition, distribution, people and infrastructure costs.

pmCanvas.label: Project Model Canvas
pmCanvas.description: 13 blocks to model a project: why, what, who, how, when and how much.

objetivo_smart.label: SMART goal
objetivo_smart.hint: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound.

justificativas.label: Rationale
justificativas.hint: What motivated the project? Problems/opportunities that started it.

beneficios.label: Benefits
beneficios.hint: The value the goal creates once it's reached.

produto.label: Product
produto.hint: What will be delivered — description of the final product/service.

requisitos.label: Requirements
requisitos.hint: Conditions and capabilities the product must meet.

stakeholders.label: Stakeholders and external factors
stakeholders.hint: People/areas affected by or affecting the project, and external factors.

equipe.label: Team
equipe.hint: Who carries out the project and their roles.

premissas.label: Assumptions
premissas.hint: Hypotheses taken as true for planning.

linha_tempo.label: Timeline
linha_tempo.hint: Milestones and deadlines of the deliverables.

riscos.label: Risks
riscos.hint: Uncertain events that may impact the project, and responses.

custos.label: Costs
custos.hint: Cost estimate of the deliverables and the project.

wiki.label: Document (Wiki)
wiki.description: Free-form markdown document for general project documentation.
